standard_prerequisites.name: A quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme with the resolution property has affine diagonal
On a quasi-compact scheme with affine diagonal every perfect object is represented by a complex of quasi-coherent modules
On a quasi-compact scheme a perfect object is bounded, so a suitable truncation of F is a bounded below complex of quasi-coherent modules representing E
standard_prerequisites.use: Prepares the input for the strictly perfect construction.

standard_prerequisites.name: A bounded below complex of quasi-coherent modules representing a perfect object on a scheme with the resolution property can be replaced by a strictly perfect complex
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes the bounded finite locally free representative.

core_obligations: Deduce affine diagonal of X from the resolution property by the resolution-property affine-diagonal lemma (proof lines 9899-9900).
Represent the perfect object E by a complex F of quasi-coherent O_X-modules via the quasi-compact affine-diagonal proposition (proof lines 9901-9903).
Since X is quasi-compact E lies in D^b; take tau_{>= n} F for n << 0 to get a bounded below complex of quasi-coherent modules representing E (proof lines 9904-9907).
Apply the strictly-perfect construction lemma to conclude E is represented by a bounded complex of finite locally free modules (proof lines 9907-9908).
proof_roadmap: Represent E by a complex of quasi-coherent modules and truncate to a bounded below one (proof lines 9901-9907).
Replace the truncated complex by a strictly perfect one (proof lines 9907-9908).
